title: Machine-Readable Operator Manuals over the ISO 11783 Network for Offline, Multilingual LLM Assistance
abstract: arXiv:2610.31863v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: If agricultural machinery is to support intelligent, offline assistance, then the system must access technical documentation dynamically. In this paper, the Semantic Synchronization of operator manuals over ISO 11783-based CAN buses is analyzed, defined as the process that brings the local knowledge base of a tractor-side assistant into agreement with the operator manual of the connected implement. Data transfer performance was benchmarked using Markdown, JSON, and XML; various open-weight Large Language Models (LLMs) were also evaluated in cross-lingual query tasks. The automatic evaluation of the answers was validated against four human raters. A complete manual was transferred over a physical ISO 11783 network in 31 to 89 s, depending on format and transport settings, which is comparable to the object pool upload that operators already wait for at the first coupling of an implement. translated_title: 基于ISO 11783网络的机器可读操作手册，用于离线多语言大语言模型辅助
translated_abstract: 如果农业机械要支持智能化的离线辅助，那么系统必须能够动态访问技术文档。本文分析并定义了基于ISO 11783的CAN总线上操作手册的语义同步，即将拖拉机侧助手的本地知识库与所连接机具的操作手册保持一致的过程。论文使用Markdown、JSON和XML对数据传输性能进行了基准测试，并评估了多种开源权重的大语言模型（LLM）在跨语言查询任务中的表现。答案的自动评估结果经过四位人工评审员的验证。根据格式和传输设置的不同，一份完整手册通过物理ISO 11783网络的传输时间为31至89秒，这与操作员在首次连接机具时已经习惯等待的对象池上传时间相当。Markdown生成的文件最小，而……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出在ISO 11783网络上对操作手册进行语义同步，使拖拉机侧的离线多语言LLM助手能够在31至89秒内获取完整的机具文档，传输时间与操作员首次连接机具时等待对象池上传的时间相当。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes semantic synchronization of machine-readable operator manuals over the ISO 11783 network, enabling a tractor-side offline multilingual LLM assistant to obtain complete implement documentation in 31 to 89 seconds, comparable to the object pool upload time operators already wait for at first implement coupling.
